title: Life of an Upgrade Credit, Extension and the Return Window: Guarantee Certificate Terms
content:
Printed on the guarantee certificate the customer receives under each of the Belrose Trade-In and Upgrade Programmes are the number of calendar days the credit may be spent within, whether an expiring credit may be extended and on what terms, and the number of calendar days within which the customer may withdraw the traded piece and give the credit back.

## Clause 1 — How long the credit lasts

| Programme | Credit may be spent within (calendar days) |
|---|---|
| Belrose Standard Trade-In | 90 |
| Diamond Trade-Up Guarantee | 365 |
| Bridal Upgrade Guarantee | 730 |
| Lifetime Diamond Upgrade Guarantee | 0 — the credit does not expire |
| Signature Collection Upgrade Privilege | 0 — the credit does not expire |
| Estate Purchase and Consignment Programme | 180 |

## Clause 2 — Extension

| Programme | Extension available | Days an extension adds (calendar days) | Extension fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Belrose Standard Trade-In | no | 0 | 0 |
| Diamond Trade-Up Guarantee | yes | 90 | 50 |
| Bridal Upgrade Guarantee | yes | 180 | 75 |
| Lifetime Diamond Upgrade Guarantee | no | 0 | 0 |
| Signature Collection Upgrade Privilege | no | 0 | 0 |
| Estate Purchase and Consignment Programme | yes | 90 | 100 |

## Clause 3 — Withdrawing the traded piece

| Programme | Days within which the piece may be withdrawn and the credit given back (calendar days) |
|---|---|
| Belrose Standard Trade-In | 7 |
| Diamond Trade-Up Guarantee | 14 |
| Bridal Upgrade Guarantee | 14 |
| Lifetime Diamond Upgrade Guarantee | 21 |
| Signature Collection Upgrade Privilege | 30 |
| Estate Purchase and Consignment Programme | 10 |

## Reading the certificate

- The two programmes whose credit does not expire are also two of the three that offer no extension; there is nothing to extend.
- The Bridal Upgrade Guarantee gives the longest expiring credit, 730 calendar days, and the longest extension, 180 calendar days for a fee of 75 USD.
- The withdrawal window and the life of the credit are two different periods: under the Diamond Trade-Up Guarantee the piece may be withdrawn within 14 calendar days, while the credit itself lasts 365.
